s.n: Island platter of haloumi, feta and figs
s.note: Griddled haloumi, honey thyme feta, olives, fresh figs and warm pita.
s.how: Griddle 250g sliced haloumi until golden and squeeze lemon over. Drizzle 150g feta with honey and thyme. Arrange on a big platter with olives, 4 halved figs and 4 warm pita breads.

s.n: Amazon spinach and leek filo pie
s.note: Spinach, leek and dill in crackling filo, cut in squares, golden as the Lasso of Truth.
s.how: Spinach, leek, dill and egg with grated parmesan, layered in buttered filo and baked golden, cut into squares. Wilt 500g spinach and squeeze dry. Soften 2 sliced leeks in 2 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes. Mix with the spinach, a bunch of chopped dill, 2 eggs and 80g grated parmesan. Layer 6 sheets of filo brushed with 60g melted butter in a tin, spread the filling, top with 6 more buttered sheets, score into squares and bake at 190°C for 40 minutes.

m.note: Lamb shoulder baked slow in paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, a feast for a queen.
m.how: Lamb shoulder sealed in baking paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, baked low until it falls apart. Rub 1.5kg lamb shoulder with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of a lemon, 2 tsp dried oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Sit it on 800g halved potatoes and 2 sliced onions, wrap tight in baking paper and foil and bake at 160C for 3 hours 30 minutes. Open, raise to 200C and brown for 20 minutes.

w.n: Diana's raspberry ripple ice cream cones
w.note: Homemade vanilla custard ice cream rippled with raspberry sauce.
w.how: Heat 300ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 120g caster sugar, whisk in the hot milk and cook to 82C, stirring. Strain and chill overnight, then churn. Simmer 200g frozen raspberries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes, sieve and cool. Layer the ice cream and sauce in a container, swirl once with a knife and freeze 4 hours. Scoop into cones.

d.note: Chilled white wine stirred with warm honey and orange peel, old Greek oenomeli for a warrior's toast.
d.how: White wine sweetened with warm honey and orange peel, chilled and poured over ice. Warm 80g honey with the peel of an orange and 60ml water until runny, cool, then stir into a 750ml bottle of chilled dry white wine. Pour over ice with an orange twist.
